title: Guardrail Maintenance
description: Use this service request to report damages to existing guardrails or treated posts. If the damages could pose a Hazardous condition that could be detrimental to vehicular or pedestrian traffic, please dial 3-1-1. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: What is the problem with the guardrail?
What is the location of the guardrail?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for existing guardrails or treated posts with damaged or missing rail or posts, or overgrown vegetation, at a street end, roadside, sidewalk, or another described location.
actions.why: For existing guardrails or treated posts with damaged or missing rail or posts, or overgrown vegetation, at a street end, roadside, sidewalk, or another described location.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Guardrail Maintenance" requests does not apply when damage could pose a hazard detrimental to vehicular or pedestrian traffic. If the damage could pose that hazard, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Guardrail Maintenance"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Guardrail Maintenance"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a hazardous guardrail.
actions.why: For guardrail damage that could pose a hazard detrimental to vehicular or pedestrian traffic; the description for "Guardrail Maintenance" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs people to dial 311.
